diagnosis: PDF export previously reset the image request set and fetched every image again, including images already decrypted and displayed. BaseNostrRepository serializes image operations through one mutex, and the export waited for all image callbacks and WebView decodes before opening PrintManager. Multiple images therefore caused redundant sequential network/decryption/base64 work and increased the chance of a slow or failed export.
changes: Reuse images already decrypted in the editor; only unresolved note images are requested for print.
Track image requests in flight to avoid duplicate requests during initial rendering and PDF preparation.
A failed image request clears its in-flight state so a later PDF attempt can retry it.
Add an instrumented regression for a note containing two distinct images and verify loaded images are not requested again for PDF.
